pairingTokenHint: Printed by the local server when it starts.
customModelHint: Overrides the dropdown. Leave empty to use “Default”.
noModelFlag: {agent} doesn’t accept a model flag here — it uses your signed-in default.
localHint: Using a local agent or Ollama works best when Studio itself runs locally (`npm run dev`).
useOllamaServer: Use Ollama through the local server
loopbackOnly: Only a URL on this machine (localhost or 127.0.0.1) is allowed — Studio will not send the pairing token anywhere else.
